items.name: solid-glass
items.title: Solid Glass
items.description: The stylesheet: the whole material in one file. Thick, smoky glass for every shadcn/ui component you already have.

items.name: ask-card
items.title: Ask Card
items.description: A decision the agent has put to the user, with its choices as buttons.

items.name: composer
items.title: Composer
items.description: Where a message is written: a pane of glass holding its tags, its text and the mark that sends it.

items.name: context-ring
items.title: Context Ring
items.description: How full the context window is, as a ring. Opened, the numbers and what it is full of.

items.name: diff-view
items.title: Diff View
items.description: A patch as a diff: added and removed lines coloured, file headers dropped.

items.name: dot-loader
items.title: Dot Loader
items.description: Three dots flashing in turn: the smallest sign that something is still running.

items.name: panel
items.title: Panel
items.description: The thinnest pane of glass, with a title bar: what a page is laid out in.

items.name: reasoning
items.title: Reasoning
items.description: The model's thinking, folded away by default.

items.name: status-glyph
items.title: Status Glyph
items.description: Three points of light that say a turn is going, and what it is doing.

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: Something attached to what is being written. While it uploads, the tag is its own progress bar.

items.name: task-notice
items.title: Task Notice
items.description: News of something ending behind the conversation: a dot for how it went, a line for what it was.

items.name: tool-steps
items.title: Tool Steps
items.description: A run of tool calls folded into one line, which opens to what each one did.

items.name: turn-status
items.title: Turn Status
items.description: The line a turn ends on for as long as it is going: what it is doing, for how long, and how much it has written.

items.name: agent-workspace
items.title: Agent workspace
items.description: A dashboard with sidebar, charts and data table
